components.name: CTA Prompt
components.description: The single bordered, button-like element — the contact mailto link, styled as a live shell prompt with a blinking cursor.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.4em 0.7em; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,179,0,0.50); border-radius: 4px; color: #FFB300; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta:hover, .ds-cta:focus-visible { border-color: #FFB300; background-color: rgba(255,179,0,0.08); color: #FFF3DC; } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFF3DC; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cta:active { border-color: #FFF3DC; background-color: rgba(255,179,0,0.14); color: #FFF3DC; } .ds-cursor { color: #FFF3DC; animation: ds-blink 1000ms step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%, 49.9% { opacity: 1; } 50%, 100% { opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Status Flag Link
components.description: Status-bar social/contact links, styled as CLI flags (--github, --x).
components.css: .ds-flag { color: #FFB300; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(255,179,0,0.35); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease, text-decoration-color 120ms ease; } .ds-flag:hover, .ds-flag:focus-visible, .ds-flag:active { color: #FFF3DC; text-decoration-color: #FFF3DC; background-color: rgba(255,179,0,0.08); } .ds-flag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFF3DC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Terminal Manifest
components.description: The 3-line service list, styled as a CLI flag/description key-value listing.
components.html: <dl class="ds-manifest"><dt>--design</dt><dd>brand-true UI, from scratch</dd><dt>--build</dt><dd>production Next.js front-end</dd><dt>--ship</dt><dd>live in days, launch-ready</dd></dl>
components.css: .ds-manifest { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9ch 1fr; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-manifest dt, .ds-manifest dd { color: #B98A3A; line-height: 1.5; white-space: nowrap; text-align: left; } .ds-manifest dt { font-weight: 500; } .ds-manifest dd { font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: The whole page is staged as one live terminal pane — the studio's own daily material, not a category-default scrolling agency portfolio. A visitor reads it the way a developer reads a CI log: a boot line, a status line, a short manifest, a live prompt. The zero-scroll constraint isn't a limitation routed around; it's the concept. Color is monochrome-phosphor, not accent-on-neutral: nearly all text renders in one amber family, the way a real CRT terminal only ever has one phosphor color. The brand mark's green is confined to a single literal "online" LED — never a background, never a second theme color.
keyCharacteristics: Single monospace type family end to end, no display/body split
Three-row bounded grid (chrome bar / content / status bar), never a scrolling page
Motion is a one-shot boot sequence plus a persistent cursor blink, not scattered hover flourishes

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: The logo's green never becomes a site color. Its entire on-page budget is the chrome-bar "online" LED dot.

rules.name: The One Phosphor Rule
rules.body: All text on the page is a shade of amber (bright or dim) or the warm cursor-flash white. No blue, no gray-as-neutral-text.

rules.name: The dvmin Rule
rules.body: Every fluid size is clamp(floor, N·dvmin, ceiling), never a vw-only or vh-only formula — the mechanism that keeps the zero-scroll constraint safe on both portrait and landscape viewports.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is never simulated with box-shadow except the literal LED glow. Framing comes from the two-tone background split, not from elevation.

dos: Do keep all body/label text in the amber family (bright or dim) — never introduce a gray neutral for "de-emphasized" text.
Do compute any ch-based grid track in the same font-size context as the text it sizes for.
Do hold interactive touch targets at a real 44px min-height, not just adequate padding.
Do theme browser-default surfaces (::selection, focus rings) rather than leaving them at browser defaults.
donts: Don't let the logo's green leave the "online" LED.
Don't add a second type family for "contrast" or "hierarchy".
Don't add drop shadows, gradients, or rounded cards to extend this system.
Don't let any new element grow the page past 100dvh/100dvw.
